calls.statement: SELECT week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at FROM fact_stock_week WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-06' ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at

SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) n, count(distinct (store_key, product_key)) dist_keys, count(distinct etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-06' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT fs.week_ending_date, count(*) n, sum(closing_units) units, sum(receipts_units) rec, sum(adjustment_units) adj
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=124 AND p.sku=100011 AND fs.week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.sales_line_id, f.channel_code FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=124 AND p.sku=100011 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24' ORDER BY 1
